_note: Single-source (Kievan Rus). Slavic sub-palette of the Slavic family with a Byzantine-GREEK (Hellenic) overlay from trade and conversion; a river-trade princedom of golden-domed cities. civ = feudal (the Velikii Knyaz over knyazes and boyars; a Byzantine court and church register). Even split Lawful/Neutral. Distinct from the pagan forest-clan Velesan: Kyivan is settled, princely and Hellenized (the One raised supreme, monastyr and sobor for kapishche, Tsar < Greek Kaisar, Greek -ios/-ia on the holy names and Greek baptismal names). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Slavic/Greek register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Slavic morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_slavic.json theonym_set) under a Greek overlay, never real Slavic or Greek gods.

phonology.palette: Slavic base (palatalization; sibilants sh/zh/ch/shch; -ov/-ich; dithematic glory-names) with a Hellenic overlay from Byzantine contact: Greek loanwords, -ios/-ia endings on the high register, the Church-Slavonic ecclesiastical vocabulary; theophoric stems are the Slavic morphs with a Greek tint (Tulorios-, Numirios-, Relatia-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC and heavy clusters (str, zdr, vl, mn); palatalized pairs; mobile stress; Greek -os/-ios in loans.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -ovich / -ich (son of); the rod (boyar house); the clergy and devout take a Greek baptismal name (often -ii / -ios).
morphology.compounding_rule: dithematic glory-names (-slav, -mir, -volod); toponyms quality + feature (Zlat-grad = golden-city, Bel-gorod = white-town); Greek -pol for the great ports (Tsargrad-style).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Kievan-Rus river-princedom: the Velikii Knyaz of Kyivgrad over the knyazes and boyars, the druzhina and the veche, with a Byzantine-Greek court and church overlay)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Slavic feudal, ascending, with a Byzantine overlay at the top: Tsar (< Greek Kaisar < Caesar) is the Hellenized imperial title over the Tsarstvo, raised above the Velikii Knyaz (grand prince of Kyivgrad) and the knyazes. Boyarin (boyar-lord) barony; Posadnik (appointed town/frontier-governor) march; Namestnik (vicegerent) county; Voevoda (war-leader) duchy. The veche checks the prince. (Rank titles are the real Slavic/Greek register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal (dithematic -slav/-mir, or a Greek baptismal name) + patronymic -ovich; the boyar rod; a Greek saint-name for the devout.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the knyaz- and boyar-houses use dithematic Slavic glory-names; the clergy and devout take Greek baptismal names (-ii / -ios).
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoking the morphed powers + a Slavic element (-slav glory, Bog- god), increasingly displaced by Greek saint-names under the Hellenization: e.g. Tuloslav, Bogumir, alongside the Greek-form devotional names.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Slavic morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_slavic.json theonym_set) under a Byzantine-Greek (Hellenized) overlay (-ios/-ia endings) - never real Slavic or Greek gods. Lawful/Neutral henotheist: under the Hellenization the One (Otirios) is raised supreme and worshipped in golden-domed sobors; the old kapishche idols give way to the ikona and the monastyr. Neutral folk still keep the Dedy (ancestral dead) at the grave.
religion.the_one: Otirios (< Slavic Oterun < Aeternus; God Most High, raised supreme under the Hellenization, worshipped in the domed churches)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the opposing powers keep their Slavic-Greek morphs + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power): Maraxus -> Marakhios the War-Fire; Vacidus -> Vakidios the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Lusanios the Hoard-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Monastyr (monastery) or Sobor (cathedral) of [power]: 'the Sobor of Tulorios', golden-domed, with ikony within.
religion.saints_pattern: Svyatyi [name] (saint), Greek-form names favored; the Dedy (ancestral dead) still honored at the grave by the Neutral.

holy_symbol_motifs.Otirios: an all-seeing eye within a golden dome
holy_symbol_motifs.Tulorios: a sun-disc above a domed sanctuary
holy_symbol_motifs.Relatia: the veiled mother above a healing-spring

banks_patterns.ships: river-trade ladya boats and Greek-style galleys: 'the Golden Dome', 'Star of the Sea', 'the River-runner'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [knyaz] Druzhina / the [city] Polk (regiment): 'the Grand Druzhina of Kyivgrad', 'the Golden Polk'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned monastyri and burned grads: 'the Sobor of [name]', 'the Sunken Grad of [knyaz]'

flagship_settlements: Kyivgrad (the mother of cities, the chief seat)
